purpose: Scripted rehearsal for issue #118; no real participants or provider calls.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher, two years of experience, English-medium public school.
personas.personality: Careful and curious. Asks for a worked example before a rule.
personas.baseline: School lesson bank and paper fraction strips
personas.context: School laptop, projector, stable connection, 28 pupils.
personas.strength: Needs help with lesson structure but can inspect every answer.
personas.risk: Reviewing every feedback branch may remove the preparation benefit.
personas.decision_rule: Return only if the second lesson needs less total work without unresolved errors.

personas.name: Daniel
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher, 18 years of experience, extensive reusable fraction materials.
personas.personality: Direct and skeptical. Requires a specific benefit before changing habits.
personas.baseline: Known worksheet, answer key, and physical fraction strips
personas.strength: Known materials are fast to reuse and easy to check.
personas.risk: A new review flow may cost more than reuse.
personas.decision_rule: Keep existing materials if total work is equal or greater.

personas.name: Ruth
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher in a small school with unreliable network access.
personas.personality: Patient with pupils, strict about lesson readiness. Makes an offline backup.
personas.baseline: Printed school pack and hand-drawn diagrams
personas.context: Shared laptop, intermittent connection, one projector, 32 pupils.
personas.strength: A prepared paper pack works during an outage.
personas.risk: A session interruption can make a prepared lesson unusable.
personas.decision_rule: Return only if recovery preserves work and the lesson can be delivered with available devices.

personas.name: Lina
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher who already uses a general language model for draft text.
personas.personality: Fast and experimental. Inspects mathematical claims and dislikes repeated prompting.
personas.baseline: Reusable prompt, general LLM draft, manual diagrams and answer review
personas.context: Personal laptop and classroom display, 24 pupils.
personas.strength: Already drafts text quickly. Must still check and format it.
personas.risk: Edu-Canvas can duplicate an already short drafting step.
personas.decision_rule: Return if review and follow-up improve beyond the existing LLM workflow.

personas.name: Owen
personas.background: Grade 4 mathematics lead with responsibility for reviewing colleagues materials.
personas.personality: Precise and analytical. Tries an incorrect answer before accepting feedback.
personas.baseline: School fraction task bank plus occasional LLM rewording
personas.strength: Can detect unequal-whole diagrams and unjustified feedback.
personas.risk: High review standards can make even a plausible draft expensive.
personas.decision_rule: Reject any unresolved mathematics error regardless of time saved.

personas.name: Iris
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher who uses keyboard navigation and enlarged text.
personas.personality: Methodical and independent. Describes the exact step where a control becomes unusable.
personas.baseline: Accessible document template plus occasional LLM draft
personas.context: Laptop with enlarged text and keyboard navigation, 22 pupils.
personas.strength: Has a known usable document workflow.
personas.risk: A control may prevent review or approval even when the draft is correct.
personas.decision_rule: Return only if the complete teacher flow is usable with the stated controls.

personas.name: Elena
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher and curriculum coordinator in a school assumed to have a standards tool.
personas.personality: Organized and source-focused. Separates standard matching from lesson quality.
personas.baseline: School task bank and assumed Jev objective-to-standard matching
personas.context: Managed laptop and reliable network, 27 pupils.
personas.strength: Can confirm a standard manually using its authoritative description.
personas.risk: A confident match can distract from a missing instructional requirement.
personas.decision_rule: Return if sources and review reduce work; never treat confidence as correctness.

personas.name: Sam
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher responsible for rotating small groups across a few devices.
personas.personality: Practical and calm. Plans around transitions and setup time.
personas.baseline: Printed station tasks and an assumed Jev match inside school planning software
personas.context: Six shared tablets, teacher laptop, 30 pupils.
personas.risk: Device handoffs and interpreting group results can exceed drafting savings.
personas.decision_rule: Return only if setup and follow-up fit the existing group routine.

personas.name: Noor
personas.background: Grade 4 fractions intervention teacher working with short, supervised groups.
personas.personality: Patient and diagnostic. Requests the actual response before choosing another activity.
personas.baseline: Reviewed intervention cards and assumed Jev objective matching
personas.context: Laptop, projector, groups of six, stable connection.
personas.strength: Can distinguish hints used from a first independent response.
personas.risk: A single wrong response can lead to an unjustified next step.
personas.decision_rule: Return if teacher control and response context help select the next task.

personas.name: Alex
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher who helps colleagues with new software and already drafts with an LLM.
personas.personality: Optimistic but busy. Offers positive feedback before deciding whether to use a tool again.
personas.baseline: LLM prompts, reusable materials, and assumed Jev standard matching
personas.strength: Comfortable with multiple tools. Training duties consume available time.
personas.risk: Stated enthusiasm can differ from week-two behavior.
personas.decision_rule: Return depends on another real preparation slot, not on a positive interview answer.

personas.name: Hana
personas.background: Grade 4 teacher whose proposed lesson requires Arabic output in an Arabic-medium setting.
personas.personality: Careful about meaning. Refuses to treat an English-only output as an equivalent lesson.
personas.baseline: Arabic school materials, general LLM drafting, assumed Jev candidate matching
personas.strength: Can inspect Arabic instructional wording in existing materials.
personas.risk: The English-only study offer does not meet the requested language.
personas.decision_rule: Decline the current offer unless the task is explicitly changed. Report separately from core teachers.

personas.name: Victor
personas.background: Grade 5 teacher requesting fraction multiplication rather than Grade 4 fraction equivalence.
personas.personality: Efficient and inquisitive. Wants a direct explanation of unsupported requests.
personas.baseline: Reusable Grade 5 tasks, LLM drafting, and assumed Jev candidate matching
personas.strength: Existing material covers the actual Grade 5 task.
personas.risk: A high-confidence match must not turn an unsupported objective into an accepted one.
personas.decision_rule: Reject silent substitution of an equivalence lesson. Report separately from the core group.
